image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a tiger beetle (likely genus Tricondyla or similar long-legged species) perched on a green leaf. The beetle has a distinctively elongated, narrow body with a textured, dark metallic exoskeleton featuring pale speckling. It possesses extremely long, slender orange legs and very long filiform antennae. The head features large compound eyes and visible mandibles.
